text:
```yaml
name: Release Scrapers

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install runtime dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libev4 libonig5

      - name: Build scraper binary
        run: |
          # Build the scraper (Makefile defaults to dune exec for local dev)
          make
          # Locate the built binary
          SCRAPE_BIN=$(find . -name scrape.exe -print -quit)
          if [ -z "$SCRAPE_BIN" ]; then
            echo "Error: scrape.exe not found after build."
            exit 1
          fi
          # Copy to repository root for release
          cp "$SCRAPE_BIN" ./scrape.exe

      - name: Upload scraper binary to release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: scraper-latest
          name: Scraper latest
          body: |
            Latest pre‑built scraper binary for ocaml.org.
          files: scrape.exe
          draft: false
          prerelease: true
```
